playstyle.identity: Wukong is a trickster diver who can clone himself and knock up entire teams twice. His ultimate spins through teamfights dealing consistent damage.
playstyle.howToPlay: Passive gives armor from nearby enemies. Q empowers auto and shreds armor. W creates a clone and goes invisible (clone attacks and mimics R). E dashes to enemies. R spins, knocking up (can recast for 2nd knockup). W to bait abilities, E-R for engage.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Wukong spikes at level 6 with his double knockup. Divine Sunderer scales him. He's strong in teamfights with AoE CC.

passive.name: Stone Skin
passive.summary: Gain armor for each nearby enemy champion.
passive.details: Wukong gains bonus armor for each nearby enemy champion.

abilities.name: Crushing Blow
abilities.summary: Empower next auto to deal bonus damage and shred armor.
abilities.details: Wukong's next auto attack deals bonus damage and reduces the target's armor for a few seconds.

abilities.name: Warrior Trickster
abilities.summary: Become invisible and leave a clone that attacks and mimics R.
abilities.details: Wukong becomes invisible and dashes, leaving behind a clone that attacks and uses Cyclone if Wukong does.

abilities.name: Nimbus Strike
abilities.summary: Dash to an enemy, dealing damage and gaining attack speed.
abilities.details: Wukong dashes to an enemy, creating clones that strike nearby enemies. He gains attack speed after landing.

abilities.name: Cyclone
abilities.summary: Spin, knocking up enemies. Can recast for a second spin.
abilities.details: Wukong spins his staff, dealing damage and knocking up enemies. He can recast to spin again, knocking up enemies a second time.
